validate_sec_details().body:
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.document_revision r
        JOIN public.document d ON d.document_id = r.document_id
        JOIN public.provider p ON p.provider_id = d.provider_id
        JOIN public.company c ON c.company_id = NEW.issuer_company_id
        WHERE r.revision_id = NEW.revision_id
          AND d.record_type = 'sec_filing' AND p.code = 'sec_edgar'
          AND r.source_category = 'official_filing'
          AND d.source_namespace = NEW.cik
          AND d.source_record_id = NEW.accession_number
          AND c.cik = NEW.cik
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SEC details must match filing identity, issuer CIK and category';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;

current_event_membership.definition:
SELECT m.membership_id,
    m.event_id,
    m.revision_id,
    m.document_id,
    m.relation,
    m.segment_key,
    m.analysis_id,
    m.comparison_id,
    e.is_sample,
    e.status AS event_status,
    d.record_type,
    r.publisher_id,
    COALESCE(r.published_at, s.accepted_at, r.source_updated_at, r.retrieved_at) AS source_time
   FROM ((((event_membership m
     JOIN news_event e ON ((e.event_id = m.event_id)))
     JOIN document d ON (((d.document_id = m.document_id) AND (d.current_revision_id = m.revision_id))))
     JOIN document_revision r ON ((r.revision_id = m.revision_id)))
     LEFT JOIN sec_filing_details s ON ((s.revision_id = m.revision_id)))
  WHERE ((m.state = 'active'::text) AND (e.status <> 'superseded'::text));

current_event_summary.definition:
SELECT s.summary_id,
    s.event_id,
    s.language_code,
    s.version,
    s.headline,
    s.summary_text,
    s.key_points,
    s.status,
    s.generation_reason,
    s.model_provider,
    s.model_name,
    s.prompt_version,
    s.input_fingerprint,
    s.usage,
    s.created_at,
    s.published_at,
    e.is_sample,
    COALESCE(r.open_review_count, (0)::bigint) AS open_review_count,
    (COALESCE(r.open_review_count, (0)::bigint) > 0) AS under_review
   FROM ((event_summary s
     JOIN news_event e ON ((e.event_id = s.event_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.candidate_event_id AS event_id,
            count(*) AS open_review_count
           FROM (event_conflict_review r_1
             JOIN event_comparison c ON ((c.comparison_id = r_1.comparison_id)))
          WHERE (r_1.status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'in_review'::text]))
          GROUP BY c.candidate_event_id) r ON ((r.event_id = s.event_id)))
  WHERE (s.status = 'published'::text);

current_live_event.definition:
SELECT e.event_id,
    e.title,
    e.status,
    e.event_facts,
    e.flags,
    min(m.source_time) AS first_source_time,
    max(m.source_time) AS last_source_time,
    count(DISTINCT m.document_id) AS documents,
    count(DISTINCT m.document_id) FILTER (WHERE (m.record_type = 'news_article'::text)) AS articles,
    count(DISTINCT m.document_id) FILTER (WHERE (m.record_type = 'sec_filing'::text)) AS filings,
    count(DISTINCT m.publisher_id) AS publishers,
    bool_or((m.relation = 'same_event_update'::text)) AS has_updates,
    bool_or((m.relation = 'same_event_conflict'::text)) AS has_conflicts,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM event_membership p
          WHERE ((p.event_id = e.event_id) AND (p.state = 'pending'::text))) AS pending_relations,
    e.profile_id,
    e.pipeline_version
   FROM (news_event e
     JOIN current_event_membership m ON ((m.event_id = e.event_id)))
  WHERE ((e.is_sample = false) AND (e.status <> 'superseded'::text))
  GROUP BY e.event_id;

current_revision_analysis.definition:
SELECT d.document_id,
    d.record_type,
    d.is_sample,
    d.current_revision_id AS revision_id,
    a.analysis_id,
    a.profile_id,
    a.pipeline_version,
    COALESCE(a.status, 'not_analyzed'::text) AS analysis_status,
    a.skip_reason,
    a.evidence_level,
    a.index_coverage,
    a.attempts,
    a.last_error,
    a.updated_at
   FROM (document d
     LEFT JOIN revision_analysis a ON ((a.revision_id = d.current_revision_id)));
